_README: Machine-verified ground truth for the crosswalk validity layer (G1, Layer 2). Each entry records the invariant that ACTUALLY fired when an instance of that charting class was executed -- in the stdlib reference suite (redteam_suite.py, 10/10 on predicted invariant) and, where run, the live CZTA gateway red-team. This is the third independent 'grader' the human coders are triangulated against. Do NOT edit by hand except to add live-gateway rows as they are executed; regenerate the suite-derived rows with extract_ground_truth.py.
